items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I told Pete Rugolo, we used to do live dates at a party, and Pete was in with all the Hollywood crowd... So we did it at his house.

ctx.x: I was wild. Pete Rugolo, who was then the A&R person, the producer was called the artists and repertoire man. He was the producer. And I wanted to do a live date. Because Steve and I became very good friends. And the fact that he was living in New York, and he bought a home in California, and every time he’d come to visit his children he’d give me a call and — it was empty, the house. And I’d call and we’d jam. And I got bummed, when Jayne moved out here they made a house out of it, and took away our jam session…
